mapper.sql: key_id AS keyId, application_id AS applicationId, namespace_id AS namespaceId, key_code AS keyCode, source_text AS sourceText, description, source_revision AS sourceRevision, status, version, created_by AS createdBy, updated_by AS updatedBy, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO t_i18n_key (key_id, application_id, namespace_id, key_code, source_text, description, source_revision, status, version, created_by, updated_by, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{row.keyId}, #{row.applicationId}, #{row.namespaceId}, #{row.keyCode}, #{row.sourceText}, #{row.description}, #{row.sourceRevision}, #{row.status}, #{row.version}, #{row.createdBy}, #{row.updatedBy}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
mapper.sql:
FROM t_i18n_key k JOIN t_i18n_namespace n ON n.namespace_id = k.namespace_id LEFT JOIN t_i18n_translation t ON t.key_id = k.key_id AND t.locale_code = #{locale} WHERE k.application_id = #{applicationId} AND k.status = 'ACTIVE' AND k.namespace_id = #{namespaceId} AND t.translation_id IS NULL
AND t.translation_id IS NOT NULL AND t.based_on_source_revision < k.source_revision
AND t.translation_id IS NOT NULL AND t.based_on_source_revision >= k.source_revision
AND (k.key_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR k.source_text LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.text LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_i18n_key WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} ORDER BY key_code
SELECT FROM t_i18n_key WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND status = #{status} ORDER BY key_code
SELECT FROM t_i18n_key WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND key_code IN #{code}
SELECT namespace_id AS namespaceId, status, COUNT(*) AS keyCount FROM t_i18n_key WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} GROUP BY namespace_id, status

SELECT k.key_id AS keyId, n.namespace_code AS namespaceCode, k.key_code AS keyCode, k.source_text AS sourceText, k.description, k.source_revision AS sourceRevision, t.translation_id AS translationId, t.text, t.based_on_source_revision AS basedOnSourceRevision, t.version AS translationVersion, t.updated_by AS updatedBy, t.update_time AS updateTime
ORDER BY n.sort_order, n.namespace_code, k.key_code LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
